title: Anatomy3D-QB item
description: One benchmark item for answer-to-3D-object grounding over the interactive anatomy atlas. English-only. Types: F factual, R relational, A ambiguous.

type.description: F factual (single structure), R relational (>=2 structures), A ambiguous (vague reference / clarification path).

query.description: English question put to the RAG pipeline.

history.description: Prior turns for multi-turn items (type A); absent for single-turn items.

gold_structures_must.description: Keys (anatomy.json canonical, mesh-available) that must appear as chips. Subset of research/benchmark/mesh-keys.json.

gold_structures_optional.description: Keys allowed but not scored for recall (no mesh, or legitimate extras).

gold_chunk_ids.description: Relevant corpus chunk ids for recall@k, e.g. medrag-anatomy_gray:123.

gold_answer_brief.description: Short reference answer; null when it needs human authoring.

expects_clarification.description: True when a correct system should ask a clarifying question instead of answering+grounding directly (valid ambiguity).

rationale.description: Why the item exists / what it tests.

status.description: ai_reviewed = machine-generated, checked by an AI-assisted review (not human); human_verified = curated by human annotators; draft = unreviewed; rejected.

needs_curation.description: True until a human has verified query, gold and non-leakage.
